The main takeaway from our work is that
the 2-step model of PGHS-2 induction and oxidant injury in AD brain is unlikely to be correct.
the brain is a unique organ with a robust antioxidant defense system that may limit oxidative damage even in the face of chronic inflammation and increased PGHS activity.
PGHS-2 is not an important contributor to brain oxidant stress and that other mechanisms must be considered to explain increased oxidant injury during chronic inflammation.
